title: Exclude 851,968 coupled earlier-sender branches for the 2418 BIT seed
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Pair surviving sender 1968 with each of 52 earlier senders after the pinned 2418 deletion and 2922 grade-two replacement. Both demanded owners at charts 527 and 528 cannot be decoded in any of the 851,968 tested decoder branches. This grants enlarged chronological source-coordinate supports, including 14 earlier-to-later dependencies.

## Task and overlap

Refined #7852 follow-up on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, toolkit `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, and native comparator #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Extends the single-earlier-sender screen in #7993 at `e3f9211fcc188288476de79153f8ffcd450ef4e9` to two coupled paid sender changes. The other paid equations, incidences and clocks stay fixed.

## Validation

On a clean Python 3.12 extraction, `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`, `python3 -B controls.py` and `python3 -B verify_primitive.py` passed. A positive control gives the second sender forbidden coordinates, and the direct interpreter checks the actual word’s 680 forward rows.

## Open next questions

Different earlier pairs and changed incidence or readout contracts require their own source evidence.
